title: Berlin International Film Festival
metaDescription: Berlin International Film Festival: verified dates, location and OneSliders event context for Film.

overview.about: The Berlin International Film Festival - the Berlinale - is one of the 'big three' European festivals alongside Cannes and Venice, held each February. Its top prize, the Golden Bear, is among cinema's most coveted, and the festival is known for its political edge and huge public audience.
overview.nextEvent: The next Berlinale runs in February in Berlin, screening hundreds of films to one of the largest public audiences of any festival. The international jury awards the Golden Bear to the best film in the main competition.
